// Planted for tests/unit/model-call-sites.spec.ts: raw model fetches built from base-URL helpers. Never compiled or imported.
import { GATEWAY_BASE } from "./gateway";
import { getProvider, providerBaseUrl } from "./providers";

export const ask = (body: string) => fetch(`${GATEWAY_BASE()}/chat/completions`, { method: "POST", body });
export const askAgain = (body: string) => fetch(`${providerBaseUrl(getProvider("xai"))}/responses`, { method: "POST", body });
